title: Omni-Surface Hosted Endpoints: PRD for Combined Generation & Vector Services + Go‑Live Runbook
creator: Ethan Cole
description: Summary: Ship a consolidated, backward-compatible Hosted API surface that unifies generation (chat/completions) with vector services (embeddings, rerank) under a single operational contract. Goal is to reduce customer integration surface area, improve routing/fallback behavior, and enable adaptive inference profiles (latency/cost/quality presets) while maintaining existing behaviour for legacy endpoints. This ticket is the product PRD + go-live runbook for the unified surface and launch readiness checklist.
goals: Deliver a single hosted inference surface that supports chat, completions, embeddings, and rerank with consistent auth, quotas, and observability
Provide adaptive inference profiles (low-latency, cost-efficient, high-quality) customers can select per-endpoint or per-route
Ensure backward compatibility with existing endpoints for the migration window and provide a compatibility shim for SDKs
Define clear rollout gates, monitoring signals, and rollback criteria to meet SLA and reliability targets
Document acceptance criteria and runbook items so SEs and Solutions Engineers can onboard customers before GA
scope_inclusions: API surface design for /v2/omni.generate (supports chat/completions semantics) and /v2/omni.vector (embeddings + rerank primitives)
Compatibility layer that maps legacy endpoints (/chat, /completions, /embeddings, /rerank) to omni surface for 6 months
Adaptive inference profiles implementation (routing rules, model variant mapping, cost SLO enforcement)
Console dashboards per-model/per-route cost & latency, rollout controls (canary %, A/B), and per-route traces
SDK updates (Python, JS) with minimal breaking changes and detailed migration guides
out_of_scope: On-prem agent packaging or private VPC install for this release (will be tracked in follow-on Private deployment ticket)
New multimodal input formats beyond text+embeddings in this launch
Major model architecture changes or new model onboarding (model tuning work will be separate)
Billing model redesign — usage pricing remains per-token and per-embedding unit for GA
acceptance_criteria: Functional: /v2/omni.generate returns chat and standard completion shaped outputs with the same determinism knobs (temperature, top_p, max_tokens) and supports streaming and function/tool-calling semantics
Functional: /v2/omni.vector exposes embeddings and reranking endpoints; rerank accepts pairs/batches and returns score + ranked ids within 200ms P95 for small candidate sets
Compatibility: Legacy endpoints proxied to omni endpoints for at least 6 months with <0.5% deviation in response schema observed in automated smoke tests

SLO/Performance: Hosted-api-v2 must meet P95 latency targets: chat streaming initial response <= 250ms (for local-cached prefixes) and tokenization throughput that supports 500 req/s burst on dedicated lane; overall error rate < 0.5% in steady state
Cost safeguards: Default adaptive profile must not increase median cost/token by >10% compared to baseline; console shows projected per-route cost impact before activating profile
Security: End-to-end KMS integration verified for customer-owned keys (if enabled) and audit logs surface every inference request with route and model variant metadata
Observability: Each request contains request_id and token-level cost breakdown in traces; per-route dashboards surface latency, errors, cost, and quality regressions tied to eval prompt sets
Rollout: Canary tests (1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%) automated with gating: if any of three critical alarms fire (latency spike, error surge, quality regression) rollback to previous stable variant
Docs/SDK: Migration guide, sample code snippets, and an SDK patch released; deprecation notice published for legacy endpoints with migration timeline
E2E Tests: Cross-team load tests, integration tests with SDKs, and a customer-facing pre-GA pilot with at least two customers signed off
checklist: API schema finalized and accepted by API review board (PRD sign-off)
Compatibility shim implementation completed and smoke tests passing
Adaptive inference profiles documented and implemented in runtime routing layer
Console updates merged: per-route profiling, rollout control, cost preview
SDKs updated (Python/JS) and published to staging with migration examples
Security review completed and KMS integration verified in staging
Performance load test run and passing defined SLOs under simulated production traffic
Telemetry: dashboards & alerts configured and validated, test alerts triggered to on-call rotation
Pilot customers onboarded and provided feedback; at least one regression test added from pilot prompts
Go/No-Go checklist reviewed by Eng, Infra, Security, Solutions, and Support teams
Release notes, migration guide, and deprecation timeline published to docs site
Post-launch monitoring plan scheduled for 48 hours intensive monitoring and 30-day stabilization
risks_mitigation: Risk: Quality regressions when routing to more cost-efficient model variants. Mitigation: baseline eval prompt-suite + automated quality gating; conservative canary with manual hold at 25%
Risk: Unexpected tokenization/cost changes for multilingual workloads. Mitigation: add dedicated multilingual regression tests and cost projection per-region
Risk: SDK breakage. Mitigation: compatibility shim + major-version deferred; publish beta SDKs and run integrator tests on top customers
Risk: SAML/KMS integration edge cases. Mitigation: security runbook and one live customer KMS test before GA
dependencies: PM-70112 (pricing: cost projection engine for adaptive profiles)
